notes: Cash-basis county. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Only fund balances are rolled forward (beginning 8,553,741, ending 7,969,900); cash printed only at year end (Cash and Cash Equivalents 4,314,765, Investments 3,655,135, p3), no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. Statement 'Other' taxes 261,901 split: Visitors Promotion Fund 28,886 lodging tax (fund name), remainder other taxes. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (p3; totals equal the Statement of Net Position p1). Detail: General Fund and major funds (Road, Inheritance) from the budgetary comparison schedules (pp5-7; General Fund Taxes split using the p4 General Fund column); nonmajor funds from the combining statement (pp13-18), per fund column, which is more detailed than the nonmajor budget schedules (pp8-12, receipts/disbursements totals only), so those are not recorded. Nonmajor funds with no activity (Special Road, Equipment Reserve, Attorney Grant, Drug Law Enforcement, Sheriff Grant, Natural Disaster, County Building) have no detail lines. Read pages 1-18 of 18
